name: 5th and Mission Garage
note: downtown-t4.ts: grey-beige concrete parking garage, deep punched openings between square piers (Mapillary 123627807026137).

name: The Bay Area Metro Center
note: downtown-t4.ts: white stucco block of about seven storeys, blue-tinted ribbon glass, dark granite base (Mapillary 1298617837852392; the 388 Beale glass tower in the first frame is a neighbour and was not used).

name: The Clift Royal Sonesta San Francisco
note: downtown-t4.ts: 1913 buff-grey brick hotel of seventeen storeys over an arched stone base (Mapillary 1078267750731072).

name: BEI Hotel San Francisco
note: downtown-t4.ts: dark slate block with a dark-mullioned glass curtain wall over a blank dark base (Mapillary 1660392567959950). OSM says 58 m; the photograph suggests fewer storeys, height unconfirmed.

name: 55 Hawthorne Street
note: downtown-t4.ts: beige stone office, horizontal bands of recessed windows, dark base (Mapillary 580503826696857, 602306151695401).

name: 633 Folsom Street
note: downtown-t4.ts: glass-skinned tower with a sloping crown on a punched podium (Mapillary 504661188364783). The fluted tan block in the first frame is a neighbour outside the brackets; height from OSM, unconfirmed.

name: (unnamed)
note: downtown-t4.ts: sixteen-storey white and charcoal residential tower over a blank base (Mapillary 1293580345608926). OSM says 68 m; the photograph reads nearer sixteen storeys, height unconfirmed.

name: 1TENth
note: downtown-t4.ts: beige-grey concrete office of about ten storeys with ribbon windows, beside Moscone (Mapillary 870645820608611). OSM says 40 m.

name: 201 Third Street
note: downtown-t4.ts: charcoal residential tower with white balcony boxes over a glass podium (Mapillary 3236654019815486, 1770744297145744). Shares its look with the Howard Street tower (way/1258806534).

name: The White House Building
note: downtown-t4.ts: white stone and terracotta department store with a rounded corner, rusticated base and attic (Mapillary 1302537283481732). OSM says 32 m; the photograph reads about six storeys, height unconfirmed.
